segments.sn35.31:1.3: Katamā ca sā, bhikkhave, sabbamaññitasamugghātasappāyā paṭipadā?
segments.sn35.31:1.4: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhuṃ na maññati, cakkhusmiṃ na maññati, cakkhuto na maññati, cakkhuṃ meti na maññati.
segments.sn35.31:1.5: Rūpe na maññati … pe … cakkhuviññāṇaṃ na maññati, cakkhusamphassaṃ na maññati, yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na maññati, tasmimpi na maññati, tatopi na maññati, taṃ meti na maññati.
segments.sn35.31:1.7: Yañhi, bhikkhave, maññati, yasmiṃ maññati, yato maññati, yaṃ meti maññati, tato taṃ hoti aññathā.
segments.sn35.31:1.8: Aññathābhāvī bhavasatto loko bhavamevābhinandati … pe … jivhaṃ na maññati, jivhāya na maññati, jivhāto na maññati, jivhā meti na maññati.
segments.sn35.31:1.10: Rase na maññati … pe … jivhāviññāṇaṃ na maññati, jivhāsamphassaṃ na maññati.
segments.sn35.31:1.12: Yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na maññati, tasmimpi na maññati, tatopi na maññati, taṃ meti na maññati.
segments.sn35.31:1.13: Yañhi, bhikkhave, maññati, yasmiṃ maññati, yato maññati, yaṃ meti maññati, tato taṃ hoti aññathā.
segments.sn35.31:1.14: Aññathābhāvī bhavasatto loko bhavamevābhinandati … pe … manaṃ na maññati, manasmiṃ na maññati, manato na maññati, mano meti na maññati.
segments.sn35.31:1.16: Dhamme na maññati … pe … manoviññāṇaṃ na maññati, manosamphassaṃ na maññati.
segments.sn35.31:1.18: Yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na maññati, tasmimpi na maññati, tatopi na maññati, taṃ meti na maññati.
segments.sn35.31:1.19: Yañhi, bhikkhave, maññati, yasmiṃ maññati, yato maññati, yaṃ meti maññati, tato taṃ hoti aññathā.
segments.sn35.31:1.21: Yāvatā, bhikkhave, khandhadhātuāyatanaṃ tampi na maññati, tasmimpi na maññati, tatopi na maññati, taṃ meti na maññati.
segments.sn35.31:1.22: So evaṃ amaññamāno na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
segments.sn35.31:1.23: Anupādiyaṃ na paritassati. Aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati.
segments.sn35.31:1.24: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
segments.sn35.31:1.25: Ayaṃ kho sā, bhikkhave, sabbamaññitasamugghātasappāyā paṭipadā”ti.

lines: Tato taṃ hoti aññathāti tato taṃ aññenākārena hoti.
Aññathābhāvī bhavasatto loko bhavamevābhinandatīti aññathābhāvaṃ vipariṇāmaṃ upagamanena aññathābhāvī hutvāpi bhavesu satto laggo lagito palibuddho ayaṃ loko bhavaṃyeva abhinandati.
Yāvatā, bhikkhave, khandhadhātuāyatananti, bhikkhave, yattakaṃ idaṃ khandhā ca dhātuyo ca āyatanāni cāti khandhadhātuāyatanaṃ.
Tampi na maññatīti sabbampi na maññatīti heṭṭhā gahitameva saṃkaḍḍhitvā puna dasseti.
Imasmiṃ sutte aṭṭhacattālīsāya ṭhānesu arahattaṃ pāpetvā vipassanā kathitā.
Aññenākārenāti yathā maññati aniccādiākārato, aññena aniccādinā ākārena hoti.
Aññathābhāvaṃ vipariṇāmanti uppādavayatāya aññathābhāvaṃ jarāya maraṇena ca dvedhā vipariṇāmetabbaṃ.
Heṭṭhā gahitameva saṅkaḍḍhitvāti “cakkhuṃ na maññatī”tiādinā heṭṭhā gahitameva khandhadhātuāyatanāti khandhādipariyāyena ekato gahetvā punapi maññanāvatthuṃ dasseti.
Avasāne “tato taṃ hotī”ti vuttapadena saddhiṃ sabbavāresu aṭṭha aṭṭha hontīti “aṭṭhacattālīsāya ṭhānesū”ti vuttaṃ.
